testCase.description: Synthetic privately owned organics-processing and food-waste aggregation facility in the Quonset industrial area, testing a behind-the-meter biogas CHP system that uses anaerobic-digester gas from source-separated commercial food residuals.
testCase.organizationType: Private taxable commercial waste and organics-processing company
testCase.organizationSize: Single Rhode Island facility; approximately 42 employees; regional commercial food-waste and residuals customers
testCase.buildingType: Industrial organics receiving, preprocessing, and utility-yard facility
testCase.primaryActivityText: Receives packaged and unpackaged food residuals, fats/oils/grease, and food-processing byproducts; preprocesses material for anaerobic digestion; proposes to use onsite biogas for a small combined-heat-and-power generator serving process loads.
testCase.publicSourceNotes: The named company, parcel, address, tax documents, and project facts are synthetic. Public context was checked only to make the Rhode Island industrial setting plausible: Quonset Business Park is publicly described as a major commercial and industrial park in North Kingstown with utility infrastructure, and North Kingstown publishes 2026 commercial and business personal property tax rates.
testCase.notes: Designed to exercise RetroFi opportunity SOURCE_DSIRE:dsire_program_id:22798 for a taxable commercial Rhode Island biogas energy system. The fixture intentionally includes usable calculation inputs but keeps assessor confirmation pending so any estimated savings remain internal-only and excluded from default customer-facing totals.

recommendedRetrofits.displayName: Biogas CHP system using anaerobic-digester gas
recommendedRetrofits.projectDescription: Install a 375 kW AC behind-the-meter biogas combined-heat-and-power system consisting of two generator modules, digester-gas conditioning, switchgear, heat-recovery piping, controls, a concrete equipment pad, and interconnection equipment. The project offsets facility electric load and supplies recovered heat to the organics preprocessing and digester-temperature loop.
recommendedRetrofits.whyThisRetrofitIsRealistic: A food-waste and organics-processing facility can plausibly generate digester gas, has steady thermal and electric loads, and is located in an industrial district where interconnection and utility-yard equipment are realistic. The facts are not artificially perfect because assessor classification, municipal status, counterfactual ordinary tax, and final interconnection documents remain pending.

calculationTrace: Use synthetic AC nameplate capacity of 375 kW from the engineering summary.
Tangible-property branch is assumed applicable for fixture coverage: 375 kW * 500 cents = 187500 cents.
Real-property branch is assumed applicable for fixture coverage: 375 kW * 350 cents = 131250 cents.
Synthetic counterfactual ordinary annual property tax cents = 1413270.
Estimated annual savings before review = max(0, 1413270 - 318750) = 1094520 cents.
Because local_assessor_confirmation is synthetic_pending_review and the counterfactual is synthetic, suppress the amount from customer-facing totals.
